## b3010fe075b7

**Classification: Reproduced defect — repeated-color equality is absent from the generated curriculum.**

The task matches a template in a board under a one-to-one color bijection. Every canonical template repeats colors, so a solver must enforce both forward consistency (one template color always maps to one board color) and reverse consistency. Generator SHA-256 `c439ee2beb6a3c673a8f0e97ad0a1a0f6febe2ff49f2250963ca61779e26d8a9` instead assigns a distinct color to every occupied template cell and its validator explicitly rejects repeated template colors.

Reproduction:

- `self_check` rejected all 3/3 canonical inputs with `template colors must be distinct so the color bijection is unambiguous`.
- A 20-sample probe found 0/20 generated templates with a repeated color.
- `checks/audit/b3010fe075b7/counterexample.json` inserts a same-mask, color-inconsistent impostor into canonical pair 0. The canonical Racket rule (`f6a87645e50d`) does not mark it; a mask-only rival adds false 8s. The supported `arcpuzzles apply` record, input, actual output, rival output, hashes, cwd, and differing cells are all embedded there.
- The counterexample belongs to the documented rule domain but does **not** pass the current validator; that rejection is part of the defect, not a reason to discard the example.
- The after battery collected six failing stages: lint, self-check, defect lint, profile floor, semantic contract, and override contract. Rule smoke and authority sync passed, so this finding does not allege a Racket-rule error.

No audit-target source was changed. Suggested repair: generate templates with repeated-color equivalence classes, include both valid and same-mask/inconsistent distractors, remove the distinct-color validator restriction, and add a rival witness that refutes mask-only matching.

Evidence: `checks/audit/b3010fe075b7/validator-probe.json`, `checks/audit/b3010fe075b7/counterexample.json`, and `checks/audit/b3010fe075b7/battery-final/checks/b3010fe075b7_after_battery_summary.json`.

triage.reason: Short brief and general feedback read under one-minute policy; routine source repair accepted as reviewer-reported. Complete-lesson/replay/override proposals retained; durable output and portable-test subset already implemented. Both audits and unscored solves retained; no training admission.
